ballistics.name: Ballistics
ballistics.desc: Firearms and their parts. Better in dead industrial districts.

steamworks.name: Steamworks
steamworks.desc: Boilers, pistons and pressure. Everything burns coal.

galvanics.name: Galvanics
galvanics.desc: Stored lightning made by chemistry, not spells. The Combine's newest trade.

optics.name: Optics
optics.desc: Lenses, sights and analysers, including the Assayer's Lens.

automata.name: Automata
automata.desc: Clockwork machines. Tier 1 is parts; the machines come later.

smithing.name: Smithing
smithing.desc: Blades, axes and shields. Recipes come from smiths and slates, not tiers. Works the same at any Resonance.

herbalism.name: Herbalism
herbalism.desc: Draughts and essence distilling. Herbs that grow where Resonance is high.

enchanting.name: Enchanting
enchanting.desc: Binding essences and glyphs onto items. Formulae from the Collegium, tomes and ruins.

consecration.name: Consecration
consecration.desc: Priestly craft: blessings and holy water. Divine work leans on Resonance less than arcane.
